title: Karnival Jom Heboh 2026 — Venue & Carnival Rates (Media Prima)
summary: Longest-running outdoor carnival since 2003; Arabian booths 10x10 to 20x80 Platinum/Gold/Silver.
description: Venue & rates deck (8 pages, scanned). Highlights: RM15M media value, 150 brands/location, 40,000 sqm, 330k visitors/location. Sponsorship tiers extracted: Longhouse RM5k–8k, Ground RM30k, Premium RM50k, Silver RM90k, Gold RM300k, Platinum RM450k, Title RM800k. Content: Jom Heboh concert 2 nights, family games/karaoke/mascots, drama/movie stars, direct sales, Jom Lokal food + open stage. Locations: Sarawak Kota Samarahan 31 Jul–2 Aug 2026, Penang Batu Kawan 24–26 Apr, Miri 25–27 Sep, KL Stadium Merdeka 27–29 Nov, Johor Angsana 30 Oct–1 Nov. Facades Arabian 20x40/20x60/20x80.
